mentions.name: ToNotes
mentions.description: This is a simple notes app that works on any device in a web browser. Users just log in and their notes are there, with no tracking and no heavy JavaScript logic, prioritizing minimalism over complexity.
mentions.problem: Every notes app today is way too complicated just to write something down.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://tonotes.com I’m building a really simple notes app  that works on any device in a web browser. I started it after my family complained that every notes app today is way too complicated just to write something down. You just log in and your notes are there. No tracking, no heavy js logic
